segments.name: advanced-safe-smart technologies and related products
segments.description: One segment selling advanced safe and smart plug and play technologies and related products, including ceiling fans, light fixtures and the Smart Sky Platform.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one segment: advanced-safe-smart technologies and related products.

revenueModel.text: Retail customers, builders and professionals pay for third-party ceiling fans, heaters and light fixtures resold through the company's websites, paired with its plug and play technology.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially most of our revenues come from the resale of third-party products, which include ceiling fans, heaters, light fixtures, paired, to the extent possible, with our standard "plug and play" feature either built in or with an adaptive kit.

changes.text: In 2024 management concluded it would discontinue using its legacy e-commerce technology platforms.
changes.evidence: Management believes it will discontinue using its legacy platforms by October 1, 2025.
